summary: Nutrition Phase 5 (Adaptive Atlas Insights + Sunday check-in nutrition questions + Coach To-Do integration) is FULLY WORKING end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (1 skipped — no pending insight had a numeric target_change_suggestion, so the coach_from_atlas target-row insertion path was skipped rather than exercised; verified by direct Mongo query that all 21 pending insights have action='flag_coach_review' with target_change_suggestion={calories:null,protein_g:null,notes:...} which is spec-correct per _build_insight rules). Verified: POST /nutrition/insights/generate {force:true} returns 200 with cached:false and full schema (id, week_start=2026 monday, week_end=sunday, action∈allowed set, atlas_summary≤250 chars, main_issue, suggested_action, coach_review_required bool, confidence, analytics {days_total:14, days_logged, avg_calories, avg_protein_g, low_protein_days}, target_change_suggestion). {force:false} returns cached:true with same id; second {force:true} returns new id and marks the previous one status='superseded' (confirmed via /mine). /latest returns most recent non-superseded. /mine?limit=5 returns list. Sanitiser: no banned words ('cheat','bad food','dirty food','failed') in any returned text across 20 mine rows. GET /nutrition/checkin/questions returns 6 questions (all ids start with 'nutr_', types choice|text). For the seeded client goal='muscle_gain' the extra 'nutr_muscle_gain_eating' question appears (fat_loss branch verified in code). Coach: POST /coach/nutrition/scan-todos → 200 (scanned=23, tasks_created immediately deduped to 0 on second call since all 23 clients already had this-week pending insights). GET /coach/nutrition/insights/pending → 22 rows, all with coach_review_required=true, status='pending', and client_name attached. POST /coach/nutrition/insights/{id}/approve {apply_target_change:true} → 200 (approved insight left pending list). POST /coach/nutrition/insights/{id}/dismiss → 200 (row disappeared from pending). POST approve on unknown id → 404. Client hitting /coach/nutrition/{insights/pending,scan-todos,insights/{id}/approve} → 403 on all three. Frontend Client: Nutrition home renders WEEKLY ATLAS INSIGHT card between Atlas Insight tip and LOG A MEAL section — action badge REVIEW colour-matched, atlas_summary rendered on 3 lines, AWAITING LOUIS pill + VIEW ALL > link visible (testID weekly-insight-card). Tap → navigates to /nutrition/insights showing big card with FLAGGED FOR REVIEW badge, week range 'JUL 6 – JUL 12', atlas_summary paragraph, MAIN ISSUE + SUGGESTED ACTION blocks with red/green dot icons, 4-stat mini row LOGGED 1/14 · AVG KCAL 2676 · AVG P 156g · LOW-P DAYS 0, plus PREVIOUS INSIGHTS list with SUPERSEDED status pills. Tapped insight-refresh (top-right) → toast 'New insight ready' appeared after ~10s and card content updated with new atlas_summary/main_issue. /checkin was already CHECK-IN COMPLETE for this client this week (client already submitted); code inspection of app/checkin.tsx confirms /nutrition/checkin/questions is fetched and injected into the form (const nutrQs, spread into all=[...core,...dynamic,...nutrQs,...habitQuestions]). Frontend Coach: /coach/nutrition renders red-tinted pending bar '22 pending Atlas reviews' with OPEN link at top and coach-nutr-scan icon top-right. Tapped scan → toast 'Scan · 0 coach tasks created' (0 because tasks already created by earlier scan — dedupe verified in backend). Tapped OPEN → page-sheet modal 'ATLAS REVIEWS · 22' with per-client cards showing client name, FLAG COACH REVIEW action badge, atlas_summary top text, main_issue below, italic 'ATLAS SUGGESTS: …' block (suggested_action), and DISMISS + MARK REVIEWED buttons (MARK REVIEWED is the label used when the insight has no numeric target_change_suggestion; APPROVE + APPLY variant not exercised because none of the 22 pending insights carry a numeric suggestion — this is spec-correct). Tapped DISMISS on first row → 'Dismissed' toast, row removed, count 22→21. Tapped MARK REVIEWED on next row → row removed, count 21→20. Closed modal → pending bar count decreased from 22 to 20. No red-screen, no banned words in rendered UI, all critical testIDs present. Emergent LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5) responses returned in 5-15s per Atlas call under the 45s budget.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_nutrition_insights.py (~540 lines) is well-structured with shared helpers _analytics/_rule_action/_call_atlas/_build_insight/_persist_insight/_maybe_create_task. Deterministic rule-based fallback in _rule_action guarantees a valid action even when the LLM call fails or returns invalid JSON.
_sanitise + _clean deep-scrub strings/lists/dicts — verified no banned words in 20 stored rows.
_persist_insight dedupes on (user_id, week_start) by marking previous pending/info rows 'superseded' before insert — verified via test_3.
coach_review_required is force-corrected server-side: keep=false, flag_coach_review/adjust_calories=true. This prevents an LLM hallucination from bypassing coach review.

target_change_suggestion.calories/protein_g are only allowed for adjust_calories/protein_focus actions and are clamped to safety floors (1500-5000 kcal, 60-400 g). For all other actions numeric fields are forced null.
coach_scan_todos treats status ∈ {pending, info, approved, dismissed} as 'has an insight this week' so a rerun does not re-invoke the LLM unless force=true — cheap, safe, and deduped.
_maybe_create_task dedupes on coach_tasks {user_id, task_type:'nutrition_review', payload.insight_id} — verified: 2nd scan returned tasks_created=0.

Client-side app/nutrition/index.tsx polls /nutrition/insights/latest on focus and renders the card only when coach_review_required=true is required for the AWAITING LOUIS pill (verified visible). VIEW ALL link and card tap both route to /nutrition/insights via router.push.

app/nutrition/insights.tsx correctly wires insight-refresh testID to POST /nutrition/insights/generate {force:true}, shows a toast 'New insight ready' when the id changes, and lists previous insights with their status pill.

app/coach/nutrition.tsx wires coach-nutr-scan testID to POST /coach/nutrition/scan-todos, opens a modalPresentation:'pageSheet' with per-row DISMISS/APPROVE actions calling the corresponding coach endpoints; pending bar refreshes on modal close.
app/checkin.tsx correctly fetches /nutrition/checkin/questions in parallel with core/dynamic and injects into the form via all=[...core,...dynamic,...nutrQs,...habitQuestions].
Minor: /nutrition/insights/generate re-invokes _analytics + _build_insight on every force=true call, which spends an LLM call. Acceptable UX (client-driven refresh), just noting cost.
Minor: coach_scan_todos loops sequentially over all clients — with 23 clients this is fine but at hundreds it will need concurrency or batching. Not a bug.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used the 23 pending insights already created by the smoke-test in this session. During testing I approved 1, dismissed 2, and force-regenerated the client insight twice (each time the previous became 'superseded'). Final DB state: ~20 pending, 2 approved, 2 dismissed, plus several superseded per user for the current week.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 is production-ready. Nothing to fix. If re-running: (a) All existing 20+ pending insights use action='flag_coach_review' with null numeric target_change_suggestion, so the 'APPROVE + APPLY / coach_from_atlas target row insertion' path is untested against real state. To exercise it, insert a synthetic insight via db.nutrition_insights.insert_one({...action:'protein_focus', target_change_suggestion:{protein_g:180,calories:2000,notes:''}, coach_review_required:True, status:'pending', ...}) then hit /api/coach/nutrition/insights/{id}/approve {apply_target_change:true} and verify a new nutrition_targets row with target_type='coach_from_atlas', active:true appears while the previous active target flips to active:false. (b) The client already submitted this week's check-in so /checkin renders CHECK-IN COMPLETE state — to visually verify the 6 nutr_ questions in the form UI, delete the current check-in row for client@crewfit.com from mongo. (c) Frontend uses AsyncStorage cf_token on web; injecting localStorage.setItem('cf_token', <token>) is sufficient to drive playwright sessions.
